crossRefs.note: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
“Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on…
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my…
For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your…
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
“Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on…
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all…

translations.web: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
translations.bsb: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
translations.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
translations.asv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
